precepts.text: Even Deborah, who arose a mother in Israel, set her heart toward the governors and worked with the men of Israel rather than ruling over them.
precepts.point: Before a king is set in his position he is under tutors and governors; young Joash was king in rank, yet he was still a learner under Jehoiada, for even kings had to be taught. Athaliah had no place ruling Israel; being the king's mother did not make her the ruler.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 23: Jehoiada Anoints Joash and Athaliah Is Slain

precepts.why:
Deborah speaks of a time when “The inhabitants of the villages ceased, they ceased in Israel, until that I Deborah arose, that I arose a mother in Israel.” She arose a mother in Israel, yet she set her heart toward the governors and worked with the men of Israel rather than ruling over them.

That is the measure for Athaliah. Being the king’s mother did not make her the ruler, and she had no place ruling Israel. Even Deborah, a mother in Israel, did not take the rule over the men.

So when Jehoiada made the covenant “between him, and between all the people, and between the king, that they should be the Lord’s people”, and set Joash “upon the throne of the kingdom”, order was restored. Joash was king in rank, yet still a learner under Jehoiada, for before a king is set in his position he is under tutors and governors; even kings had to be taught. And once Athaliah was slain, “all the people of the land rejoiced: and the city was quiet.”

points: In the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself and took the captains of hundreds into covenant with him, and they gathered the Levites and the chief of the fathers out of all the cities of Judah to Jerusalem.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 23: Jehoiada Anoints Joash and Athaliah Is Slain

points: The congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of God, and Jehoiada declared that the king's son should reign, as the Most High had said of the sons of David.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 23: Jehoiada Anoints Joash and Athaliah Is Slain

points: He set his plan: a third part of the priests and Levites to keep the doors, a third at the king's house, and a third at the gate of the foundation, with all the people in the courts.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 23: Jehoiada Anoints Joash and Athaliah Is Slain

points: None but the priests and ministering Levites were to enter the house of the Most High, and the Levites were to compass the king round about, every man with his weapon, and put to death any who forced their way in.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 23: Jehoiada Anoints Joash and Athaliah Is Slain

points: The Levites and all Judah did according to all Jehoiada commanded, each man keeping his company, for Jehoiada did not dismiss the courses of the Levites but kept them at their work with security added for the king.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 23: Jehoiada Anoints Joash and Athaliah Is Slain

points: Jehoiada delivered to the captains the spears and shields that had been king David's, kept in the house of God, and set every man with his weapon from one side of the temple to the other, round about the king.
This was done by the proper custom: a priest anoints the king, as Samuel the priest anointed Saul and then David; so Jehoiada the priest anointed Joash.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 23: Jehoiada Anoints Joash and Athaliah Is Slain

points: They brought out the king's son, put the crown upon him, gave him the testimony, and made him king, and Jehoiada and his sons anointed him and said, God save the king.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 23: Jehoiada Anoints Joash and Athaliah Is Slain

points: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came into the house of the Most High and saw the king standing at his pillar with the princes, trumpets, and singers rejoicing.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 23: Jehoiada Anoints Joash and Athaliah Is Slain

points: She rent her clothes and cried, Treason, treason, but her cry came too late, for the covenant was already made and the true king was crowned.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 23: Jehoiada Anoints Joash and Athaliah Is Slain

points: Jehoiada commanded the captains to have her forth from the ranges and to slay any that followed her, but not to slay her in the house of the Most High.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 23: Jehoiada Anoints Joash and Athaliah Is Slain

points: They laid hands on her, brought her to the entering of the horse gate by the king's house, and slew her there, ending the reign of the woman who had killed the seed royal.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 23: Jehoiada Anoints Joash and Athaliah Is Slain

points: Jehoiada made a covenant between himself, all the people, and the king, that they should be the Most High's people, and the people went to the house of Baal, broke it down, brake its altars and images, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 23: Jehoiada Anoints Joash and Athaliah Is Slain

points: Jehoiada appointed the officers of the house of the Most High by the hand of the priests and Levites whom David had distributed, to offer burnt offerings with rejoicing and singing as ordained by David.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 23: Jehoiada Anoints Joash and Athaliah Is Slain

points: He set the porters at the gates so that none unclean in anything should enter, then brought the king down and set him upon the throne of the kingdom, and the people rejoiced and the city was quiet.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 23: Jehoiada Anoints Joash and Athaliah Is Slain

points: Before a king is set in his position he is under tutors and governors; young Joash was king in rank, yet he was still a learner under Jehoiada, for even kings had to be taught. Athaliah had no place ruling Israel; being the king's mother did not make her the ruler.
